description: Client-side script for 'Interview' doctype in ERPNext, managing interview scheduling, feedback, and related UI interactions.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initial setup when the form loads, setting query for job applicants and interviewers.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, adds buttons for rescheduling and feedback based on conditions.

methods.name: show_reschedule_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to reschedule the interview.

methods.name: show_feedback_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to submit interview feedback.

methods.name: get_fields_for_feedback
methods.description: Returns fields configuration for feedback table.

methods.name: set_job_applicant_query
methods.description: Sets query filters for job applicant selection based on designation and status.

methods.name: interview_round
methods.description: Handles changes to interview round, resets values, and updates related fields.

methods.name: set_interview_details
methods.description: Fetches and sets interviewers for the selected interview round.

methods.name: job_applicant
methods.description: Handles job applicant selection, ensuring interview round is selected first.

methods.name: set_designation_and_job_opening
methods.description: Sets designation, job opening, and resume link based on selected job applicant and interview round.

methods.name: reset_values
methods.description: Resets designation, job opening, and resume link fields.
